title: Asymmetry Tunneling Beyond Adaptive Equivariance Relaxation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29473v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Equivariant neural networks encode prescribed symmetries as powerful inductive biases, yet real-world data may exhibit symmetry-breaking structure that these priors cannot fully capture. Prior work has largely addressed this challenge through model-side equivariance relaxation, seeking an appropriate level of equivariance for the data. This raises a complementary question: must equivariance relaxation be adaptively controlled? To investigate this question, we introduce a residual path alongside a strictly equivariant model and deliberately restrict their interface to examine the transmission of task-relevant structure. Across five benchmarks, we observe both residual collapse and survival despite these restrictions; we call the latter phenomenon asymmetry tunneling. translated_title: 超越自适应等变性松弛的非对称性隧穿
translated_abstract: 等变神经网络将预设的对称性编码为强大的归纳偏置，然而现实世界的数据可能表现出这些先验无法完全捕捉的对称性破缺结构。先前的工作主要通过模型侧的等变性松弛来解决这一挑战，即为数据寻找合适的等变性水平。这引出了一个互补的问题：等变性松弛是否必须进行自适应控制？为了研究这一问题，我们在严格等变模型旁引入了一条残差路径，并刻意限制二者之间的接口，以考察任务相关结构的传递情况。在五个基准测试中，我们观察到残差在这些限制条件下既会出现坍缩，也能够存活；我们将后一种现象称为“非对称隧穿”。我们进一步通过四种互补的诊断方法对这一现象进行了刻画。我们的结果表明，等变性松弛的自适应控制并不是……的先决条件（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该研究发现，即使刻意限制严格等变模型与残差路径之间的接口，打破对称性的任务相关结构仍能通过残差路径“隧穿”进入模型（即“非对称隧穿”现象），表明等变性松弛未必需要自适应控制。
en_tdlr: Even with deliberately restricted interfaces between a strictly equivariant model and a residual path, symmetry-breaking task-relevant structure can still "tunnel" through the model—a phenomenon termed asymmetry tunneling—suggesting that adaptive control of equivariance relaxation is not a prerequisite.
